items.title: Earn up to 90% on every photo you sell
items.body: Invite photographers and unlock a bigger share of every photo sale at 10, 20, 30 and 40 referrals. Your rate rises from 70% up to 90%.

items.title: A Milestones screen for your referrals
items.body: See your rate, how many referrals you need for the next one, and exactly what each friend still has to do before they count.

items.title: Clear rules for when a referral counts
items.body: A referral counts after your friend is verified, publishes a photo and makes their first sale. The steps are explained in the app, in your language.

items.title: A compact, easier-to-scan package card
items.body: After you upload a brochure, each package shows its price, key details and included items in the same compact layout as Opportunities, with long descriptions shortened and the AI's own remarks removed.

items.title: Email code sign-in is now for team members
items.body: The email code option no longer sits under Forgot your password, so it is not mistaken for a password reset. Invited team members still see it on their own sign-in screen.

items.title: Organize step matches the rest of the app
items.body: Indoor and Outdoor are now the same tabs you see on Opportunities, selected options use a soft highlight, and the long notes in a package's delivery line are gone.

items.title: Brochure reading now runs on our servers
items.body: When you upload a package brochure, it is now read securely on our servers instead of inside the app, so reading your packages keeps working and nothing sensitive is stored on your phone.
